Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 48 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners in Marriage and Family Therapy until October 1, 2025, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 48 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners in Marriage and Family Therapy until October 1, 2025, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
